description: This is a frontend HTML page for a database visualizer that provides a user interface to browse databases, tables, and view data in tabular form, including features like refresh, expand cells, and responsive design.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading databases and resetting UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in the main view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table based on data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual data cells, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full viewing.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specified element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets active class on a DOM element and resets others.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Performs fetch API calls and handles errors.
